artifacts.baseline_parameters.json: training-label-only baseline fit state and rules in original USD
artifacts.models/*.joblib: locally fitted scikit-learn estimator trained on log1p(USD); load only after checksum verification
artifacts.predictions.csv: local row-level predictions in original USD after expm1; no native AHS identifier
artifacts.metrics.json: aggregate held-out metrics in original USD for both frozen evaluation views
artifacts.experiment_manifest.json: source hashes, fit evidence, parameters, versions, and output hashes
artifacts.qa_experiment_report.json: recomputed artifact, fit-boundary, metric, and reload checks
